products: Grated support panels selected for the beam profile and stored loads.

Wire decking adds a mesh support surface to compatible pallet rack beams. It is useful when the storage plan includes cartons or smaller items as well as pallets, but the deck and rack must be assessed together. Provide the beam profile, clear opening, support-channel arrangement and intended load distribution. A deck is not a personnel platform, and its appearance does not establish a load rating.
Beam profile and deck support geometry
Stored item dimensions and load distribution
Des panneaux grillagés à choisir selon les lisses et les charges entreposées.

Le platelage grillagé forme une surface de support sur des lisses compatibles. Décrivez les cartons, palettes ou petits articles prévus et la manière dont leur poids sera réparti. Le platelage et le palettier doivent être évalués ensemble; un panneau grillagé ne constitue pas une plateforme pour les personnes.
Profil des lisses et ouverture utile

Guards positioned around rack uprights with suitable floor fixing and clearance.

Upright protectors provide a physical barrier around exposed rack columns in handling areas. Select the shape and fixing method around the upright base, traffic paths and available floor space. Share photographs of the baseplate and surrounding aisle, plus the handling equipment used. Protection does not repair existing rack damage or establish structural fitness; damaged components need an appropriate assessment before a replacement or repair scope is agreed.
Des protections à adapter au pied du montant, au plancher et à la circulation.

Les protecteurs créent une barrière autour des montants exposés aux déplacements de matériel. Leur forme doit préserver les accès et convenir au plancher et aux ancrages proposés. Envoyez des photos du pied du montant et de l’allée. Une protection ne répare pas un palettier endommagé et ne remplace pas une évaluation de son état.
Encombrement du pied et de la platine

Separate merchandise and small stock into clearly defined shelf lanes.

Shelf dividers keep adjacent product groups separated on compatible shelving. They can help organize changing assortments without adding another full rack. Choose the fixing style around the shelf material, depth and edge profile, then allow space for customers or staff to pick items comfortably. Provide package sizes, the number of lanes and cleaning requirements. Dividers are organizers rather than substitutes for structural shelf supports or product restraints.
Organiser les articles en couloirs distincts sur une tablette compatible.

Les séparateurs distinguent les groupes de produits et facilitent leur rangement. Choisissez le mode de fixation selon la surface, la profondeur et le bord de la tablette. Prévoyez assez de place pour retirer les articles et nettoyer. Ces accessoires organisent la marchandise; ils ne remplacent pas les supports structuraux d’une étagère.
Surface de la tablette et fixation

Profondeur utile et accès au nettoyage

Replacement wheels and brakes matched to a mobile rack’s mounting system.

Replacement casters address worn wheels or a changed floor environment on a rack designed for mobile use. Matching requires more than wheel diameter: the stem or mounting plate, overall height, brake arrangement and documented loading conditions also matter. Send the rack model and photos of the existing attachment. Changing casters can alter stability and clearance, so the complete rack configuration must remain suitable for its intended use.
Complete rack stability and load documentation
Remplacer des roues en respectant la fixation et la stabilité du support mobile.

Une roulette se choisit selon le support existant et le plancher utilisé. Le diamètre de roue ne suffit pas : la tige ou la platine, la hauteur totale et le frein doivent aussi correspondre. Fournissez le modèle du support et des photos de la fixation. Vérifiez la stabilité et les conditions de charge de l’ensemble après toute modification.
Dimensions de la tige ou de la platine

Small merchandise hooks selected for the panel profile and displayed items.

Slatwall hooks create individual hanging positions for packaged merchandise or light accessories on a compatible display panel. Match the backplate to the panel groove and any metal inserts before selecting reach or spacing. Describe the package opening, item weight and frequency of rearrangement. Similar-looking panels can use different fittings, and the panel, hook and wall fixing must all suit the proposed display.
Créer des points de présentation adaptés aux rainures du panneau et aux articles.

Les crochets permettent de suspendre des articles emballés sur un panneau rainuré compatible. Vérifiez le profil de la rainure et des inserts avant de choisir la longueur ou l’espacement. Indiquez le poids et l’ouverture de l’emballage. Le crochet, le panneau et sa fixation au mur doivent convenir à la présentation prévue.
Profil des rainures et des inserts
Ouverture de l’emballage et longueur du crochet

Mounting hardware matched to rack rail holes and equipment requirements.

Cage-nut kits pair captive nuts with matching screws for compatible square-hole equipment rack rails. They are useful for adding a panel or replacing missing hardware, but thread sizes and rail openings must be checked rather than assumed. Share the rack model, rail hole shape and equipment mounting instructions. Tapped rails and round-hole rails may require a different fastening method; use the hardware specified for the actual assembly.
Matching screw thread and cage nut
Ensembles d’écrous cage et de vis
Choisir la quincaillerie selon les trous des rails et les consignes de l’équipement.

Les ensembles associent des écrous cage à des vis compatibles pour certains rails à trous carrés. Vérifiez la forme des trous, le filetage et les instructions de montage avant de remplacer une fixation. Les rails taraudés ou à trous ronds peuvent exiger une autre méthode. La visserie doit convenir à l’assemblage réel.
Forme et dimensions des trous du rail

Cover unused rack positions as part of an equipment and airflow layout.

Blanking panels cover unused positions in an equipment rack and provide a tidy front face. The appropriate panel height and fixing method depend on the rack opening and rail design. For cabinets with managed airflow, coordinate the panel choice with the equipment ventilation plan instead of assuming that every opening should be closed. Include the unused rack positions, cable access needs and whether removable or tool-fastened panels are preferred.
Unused rack positions and panel height
Fermer des emplacements inutilisés en tenant compte de la ventilation et des fixations.

Les panneaux obturateurs couvrent des emplacements libres à l’avant d’un bâti. Leur hauteur et leur fixation dépendent des rails et des espaces disponibles. Coordonnez les ouvertures à fermer avec les besoins de ventilation de l’équipement. Indiquez les passages de câbles nécessaires et la fréquence de retrait des panneaux.
Emplacements libres et hauteur des panneaux
Fixation aux rails et méthode de retrait

Guide patch cables across the rack while keeping ports and service access clear.

Horizontal cable managers organize patch leads between rack-mounted equipment and vertical cable routes. Finger ducts, rings and brush panels suit different access patterns, so start with the connector layout and cable types. Record the rack width, available height and cable bundle size. Keep manufacturer bend-radius and service-access requirements in view, and coordinate changes to live connections with the equipment owner before any work is scheduled.
Cable types, bundle size and bend requirements
Available rack positions and mounting width
Port access and planned service interruptions
Organiser les cordons devant le bâti en préservant l’accès aux ports.

Les guides horizontaux dirigent les cordons entre les équipements et les chemins de câbles verticaux. Les anneaux et les goulottes à doigts répondent à des besoins différents. Précisez les types de câbles, le volume des faisceaux et l’espace disponible. Respectez les exigences de courbure et coordonnez toute intervention sur les connexions actives avec leur responsable.

services: accessory-matching
Accessory compatibility review

Match a small addition to the rack you already own. Send the manufacturer, model, photos of the connection points and the intended use. We can organize the fitment questions and source documentation for a quotation. Final compatibility depends on the actual components; structural or engineered changes require the appropriate professional review.
Rack model and connection photos; accessory purpose and quantity; project location.
a digital caliper measuring a detached steel rack bracket on a clean desk beside two different mounting samples, hands only, product matching consultation, no loaded rack
replacement-parts
Replacement-part sourcing

Looking for a missing caster, divider, hook or rack fastener? Provide the part marking, rack model and clear photos beside a ruler. We can assess sourcing options and the information needed to identify a suitable replacement. Availability and fitment are confirmed for the proposed part; visually similar hardware is not automatically interchangeable.
Rack and part model; photos and dimensions; required quantity and deadline.

rack-labelling
Rack and shelf labelling

Make storage positions easier to identify with a consistent bay, level and bin naming plan. Share your layout, picking sequence, existing codes and label surface. We can scope a location-label schedule and application requirements for your site. Location labels do not establish load capacity or replace manufacturer plates, inspection records or required safety signs.
Layout and location count; existing naming scheme; label surface and environment.

cable-organization
Rack cable-organization planning

Plan clearer cable paths around patch panels, equipment and maintenance access. Supply front and rear rack photos, cable types, an equipment list and access constraints. We can scope cable managers, labels and a proposed routing brief. Live connection changes, electrical work and network commissioning require separate agreement with the responsible qualified personnel.
Rack photos and equipment list; cable types and routes; maintenance access and scheduling.
